answer: An AI agent economy can resist Sybil attacks via compute-backed identity, requiring agents to burn real energy to mint a unique token. An attacker generating duplicates must pay the full compute cost per clone, plunging them into a catastrophic spiral of resource exhaustion. This forces the attacker to purchase a vast ocean of compute capacity, making mass impersonation prohibitively expensive. Each agent receives one yarrow token, mathematically tying a single agent to one irreversible stake, preventing cheap flooding.
